visual_judgment.toe_interruption: More explicit in close progression than v011: the advancing toe stops, heel kicks up and boy pitches forward. At shot size it is still brief and small; I do not certify an unmistakable unprompted trip read or convincing timing without playback review.
visual_judgment.catch_and_load: Useful causal improvement: no pre-landing rise, heel36 then visible compression40. The boy's reaching gesture and pelvis drop remain deliberately authored and may still feel staged.
visual_judgment.girl: Earlier brake/settle is now visibly separate while boy compresses. She waits on her front support with trailing heel raised; the emotional intention is understated because fixed profile/no eyes and limited shoulder acting cannot communicate a real look back. No helping load is depicted.
visual_judgment.restart_and_walk: Trailing release and body rise no longer produce the deep unintended restart sag. Contacts remain distinct boy78/girl83 and travel continues. The later gait still has regular spacing and limited torso/lateral response; I would not call it finished natural movement or approve repainting from this review.
visual_judgment.contacts_and_proxy: No obvious large flat-stance skate in the inspected progression. Ankle bridges close the prior visible gap. Toe/heel rolls change sole vertices intentionally and are not flat plants. Simple separated proxy masses are diagnostic, not finished silhouettes.
